x-changelog.summary: Introduced Public API endpoints for External RFIs
x-changelog.description:
Introduced the following Public API endpoints for External RFIs:
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis (List External RFIs)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/{id} (Show External RFI)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/{id}/revisions (List External RFI Revisions)
- PATCH /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/{id}/linked_local_rfis (Update Linked Local RFIs for an External RFI)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/{id}/download_external_rfi_and_responses_attachments (Download External RFI and Responses Attachments)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/{external_rfi_id}/advanced_exports (Show Advanced Export Options for External RFI)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/{external_rfi_id}/external_rfi_pdf_exports/{id}/download (Download External RFI PDF Export)

x-changelog.summary: Documented recycled External RFI status values
x-changelog.description: The List External RFIs response documentation now includes the existing `_recycled` status variants returned when an upstream RFI is in the recycle bin. Generated clients should handle these variants, and integrations should tolerate unknown future status values.

x-changelog.summary: Corrected the documented External RFI list response
x-changelog.description: The List External RFIs response documentation now matches the existing runtime payload for synchronization state, origin RFI/project/company IDs, project connection IDs, linked local RFIs, cross-account origin state, and the origin RFI URL. Contact objects now list only the `id` and `name` fields returned by the API. Generated clients should handle the newly documented `private` synchronization state.

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/external_rfis/%7Bid%7D/revisions?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", headers=headers)

data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
